steps.title: ground rlbench target · move rlbench arm to · close rlbench gripper
steps.code:
# Check current left_handle_visual and right_handle_visual poses
lh_res = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name="left_handle_visual")
rh_res = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name="right_handle_visual")
lh_pose = lh_res.output.get("pose_evidence", {}).get("pose_world")
rh_pose = rh_res.output.get("pose_evidence", {}).get("pose_world")
print("lh_pose:", [round(x, 5) for x in lh_pose])
print("rh_pose:", [round(x, 5) for x in rh_pose])

# Orientation from waypoint1
q = wps["waypoint1"][3:7]

# Approach left_handle_visual
pre_lh = [lh_pose[0] - 0.05, lh_pose[1], lh_pose[2]] + q
at_lh = [lh_pose[0] - 0.004, lh_pose[1] - 0.0001, lh_pose[2]] + q
# Slide left_handle_visual along the door vector:
# Note wp1 -> wp2 had dx = +0.01208, dy = -0.08515.
# Let's check the unit direction of sliding from wp1 to wp2:
dx = wps["waypoint2"][0] - wps["waypoint1"][0]
dy = wps["waypoint2"][1] - wps["waypoint1"][1]
pull_lh = [at_lh[0] + dx, at_lh[1] + dy, at_lh[2]] + q
retreat_lh = [pull_lh[0] - 0.07, pull_lh[1], pull_lh[2]] + q

r1 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_pose=pre_lh)
print("pre_lh:", r1.ok, [round(x, 4) for x in r1.output.get("observation_summary", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_pose", [])[:3]])

r2 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_pose=at_lh)
print("at_lh:", r2.ok, [round(x, 4) for x in r2.output.get("observation_summary", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_pose", [])[:3]])

rc = primitives.call(name="close_rlbench_gripper")
print("close:", rc.ok, rc.output.get("observation_summary", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_open"))

r3 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_pose=pull_lh)
print("pull_lh:", r3.ok, [round(x, 4) for x in r3.output.get("observation_summary", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_pose", [])[:3]])

ro = primitives.call(name="open_rlbench_gripper")
print("open:", ro.ok)

r4 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_pose=retreat_lh)
print("retreat:", r4.ok)

lh_after = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name="left_handle_visual").output.get("pose_evidence", {}).get("pose_world")
print("lh_after:", [round(x, 5) for x in lh_after])
